$comment: 语法大厅 G47（V0.9 P4 精修层）。比喻锚点：一张总时间表：调×时刻的坐标系。把 G06/G07/G13/G14/G16/G26/G27/G28/G40 学过的时态收进一张 4×3 坐标系（时刻：现在/过去/将来/过去将来 × 状态：一般/进行/完成），教组装零件（will 挪时刻、be+doing 进行、have+done 完成）与横向辨析三问，不逐格复述旧课。罕见三格（will be doing / will have done / would have done）诚实标灰认识即可。KET 只考其中五六格，据实标注。全部内容原创。
title: 时态十二格总览与横向辨析
metaphor: 一张总时间表：调×时刻的坐标系
ketNote: 老实说：KET 只考坐标系里最常用的五六格（一般现在/过去/将来、现在进行、现在完成七搭配）。这一课的「总表视角」是为初中/PET 打底——初中考试最爱横向辨析。不用焦虑，学到就是赚到。

sections.essence: 十二格 = 时刻 × 状态的坐标系：横轴定何时，纵轴定状态，三个零件随便组装。
sections.why: 从 G06 到 G40，时态学了一路：一般现在、现在进行、一般过去、过去进行、将来、现在完成、过去完成、过去将来……一课一格学下来，最怕的就是考试把它们摆在一起让你横向挑。其实这些格子从来不是十二条孤立的规则，而是一张坐标系：横轴是时刻——你站在哪个时间点说话（现在／过去／将来／过去里的将来）；纵轴是状态——动作在那个时刻是什么样（一般＝常态或事实，进行＝正演到一半，完成＝在那个时刻之前已经收尾）。横轴由报时的助动词管，纵轴由动词的形态管。更妙的是整张表只用三个零件组装：will/would 负责把时刻往将来挪，be + doing 负责「进行」，have + done 负责「完成」。零件会拼，十二格就不用背。
sections.metaphorStory: 期末汇演前，银帆乐团的告示栏上钉着一张总时间表。学徒凑近一看：横着四栏——昨晚场、今晚场、明晚场、还有一栏叫「昨晚说好的明晚场」；竖着三行——常规曲目、演到一半的、已经收工的。指挥说：「每个格子都是一个横竖交点。你要说的每一句话，先在横轴上找到自己站的时刻，再在纵轴上看动作的状态，格子自然就落定了。」学徒担心十二个格子记不住，指挥摇头：「不用记格子，记零件。整张表就三个零件：will 是推子，把时刻往前推；be 加 doing 是进行灯，亮着就是演到一半；have 加 done 是收工章，盖上就是那一刻之前已完成。零件能拼：will be playing 就是推子加进行灯——明晚八点正演到一半。右下角那三个偏僻格子（will have done 之类），一年用不上几回，认得出就行，高中再细学。」

cards.rule: 横轴四时刻：现在 / 过去 / 将来 / 过去将来
cards.detail: 先问自己站在哪个时间点说话。前三个好懂；「过去将来」是站在过去朝后看（G40 转述里的 would）。
cards.example: He said he would come.（昨天说的「明天」）

cards.rule: 纵轴三状态：一般 / 进行 / 完成
cards.detail: 一般＝常态、事实、整件事；进行＝在那个时刻正演到一半；完成＝在那个时刻之前已经收尾、影响还在。
will/would 挪时刻；be + doing 点进行灯；have + done 盖收工章。第一个助动词永远负责报时（G29 就见过这条分工）。
cards.example: will be doing = 推子 + 进行灯 ／ had done = 过去 + 收工章

cards.detail: ① 基准点在哪（找时间词和上下文）② 动作与基准点什么关系（常态？正在？之前已完成？）③ 横竖一交，格子落定。
cards.example: by the time + 过去 → 过去之前已完成 → had done

cards.rule: 四条对表纪律（旧课的总复习）
cards.detail: 具体过去时间（yesterday/last week/in 2019）配一般过去，不配现在完成；since/for 挂完成；时间条件从句用现在替将来（G35）；主句过去、从句跟着退（G33/G40）。
cards.example: I saw it yesterday. ✗ have seen it yesterday

cards.detail: will have done、would be doing、would have done 三格初中罕见，认识即可；know/like/love 这类状态动词一般不点进行灯。
cards.example: I know the answer. ✗ am knowing

basic.en: Our band practises every Friday afternoon.
basic.cn: 我们乐队每周五下午排练。（现在 × 一般：常态格）

basic.en: They are practising in the hall right now.
basic.cn: 他们此刻正在礼堂排练。（现在 × 进行：灯亮着）

basic.en: We practised the new piece last night.
basic.cn: 我们昨晚练了新曲子。（过去 × 一般）

basic.en: We will practise twice next week.
basic.cn: 下周我们要练两次。（将来 × 一般：推子推一格）

basic.en: We have practised this piece ten times.
basic.cn: 这首我们已经练了十遍。（现在 × 完成：收工章盖到现在）

mid.en: I was doing my homework when the lights went out.
mid.cn: 灯灭的时候我正在写作业。（过去 × 进行：昨晚的灯亮到一半）

mid.en: By the time we arrived, the show had begun.
mid.cn: 我们到的时候，演出已经开始了。（过去 × 完成：过去的过去）

mid.en: She said she would join us the next day.
mid.cn: 她说她第二天会加入我们。（过去将来 × 一般：昨天说的明天）

mid.en: Don't call me at nine — I will be taking a shower.
mid.cn: 九点别打给我——那会儿我正在洗澡。（将来 × 进行：推子+进行灯）

mid.en: He has lived in this town since 2018.
mid.cn: 他从 2018 年起一直住在这个镇上。（since 挂完成）

trap.en: I visited the science museum last Sunday.
trap.note: last Sunday 是具体过去时间——配一般过去，别盖现在完成的章。

trap.en: We will set off as soon as the rain stops.
trap.note: 时间从句用现在替将来——as soon as 后面不放 will（G35 的纪律）。

trap.en: He told me he would bring his camera.
trap.cn: 他跟我说他会带相机来。
trap.note: 主句 told 在过去——从句的将来要退成 would（过去将来格）。

trap.en: When Mum came in, I was cleaning the fish tank.
trap.cn: 妈妈进来时我正在刷鱼缸。
trap.note: came 是整件事，was cleaning 是演到一半——同一句里两格并用。
like 是状态动词——进行灯点不亮，别写 am liking。

trap.en: The train had already left when they reached the station.
trap.cn: 他们赶到车站时火车已经开走了。
trap.note: 「过去的过去」才请 had done——没有更早的参照点就轮不到它。

redBlack.bad: Last night I hear a strange noise and go downstairs.（讲昨晚的事）
redBlack.good: Last night I heard a strange noise and went downstairs.
redBlack.why: 站在过去却用现在格——听的人分不清这是昨晚的事还是天天发生的事，时间线全乱（G15 的老对头）。

redBlack.bad: When I got home, Mum cooked dinner.（想说：到家时妈妈正在做饭）
redBlack.good: When I got home, Mum was cooking dinner.
redBlack.why: cooked 是整件事——变成「我到家后妈妈才动手做」；进行灯不亮，两件事的先后就被改写了。

redBlack.bad: I have watched this film last weekend.
redBlack.good: I watched this film last weekend.
redBlack.why: last weekend 是具体过去时间——只配一般过去，现在完成的章盖不上去。

redBlack.bad: We will leave when Dad will get back.
redBlack.good: We will leave when Dad gets back.
redBlack.why: 时间从句用现在替将来——will 不进 when 的门。

redBlack.bad: She said she will call me that evening.
redBlack.good: She said she would call me that evening.
redBlack.why: 主句 said 站在过去——从句的将来退成 would，进过去将来格。

redBlack.bad: Listen! The birds sing outside the window.
redBlack.good: Listen! The birds are singing outside the window.
redBlack.why: Listen 把基准点钉在此刻——正演到一半要点进行灯。

redBlack.bad: By the time we got there, the meeting already started.
redBlack.good: By the time we got there, the meeting had already started.
redBlack.why: 「到那儿」之前就开始了——过去的过去要盖 had done 的章。

redBlack.bad: My aunt is knowing everyone in the neighbourhood.
redBlack.good: My aunt knows everyone in the neighbourhood.
redBlack.why: know 是状态动词——进行灯点不亮。

redBlack.bad: He plays basketball when I saw him in the gym.
redBlack.good: He was playing basketball when I saw him in the gym.
redBlack.why: saw 把整句钉在过去——另一半也得站过去，且是演到一半的 was playing。

redBlack.bad: We are worked on the poster since Monday.
redBlack.good: We have been working on the poster since Monday. / We have worked on it since Monday.
redBlack.why: since 挂完成——be 和 have 两套零件不能焊在一起乱拼。

redBlack.bad: I'm seeing the dentist tomorrow morning.（有人说将来必须用 will）
redBlack.good: 现在进行表已定安排，完全地道；will 也对。
redBlack.why: am seeing = 已经约好的安排——地道用法不是错，两种都行。

redBlack.bad: It will rain. / It's going to rain.（争哪个才对）
redBlack.good: 两个都对——be going to 更强调有迹象（G16）。
redBlack.why: will 与 be going to 的细微差别不挡意思，考试也很少设坑。

contrast.cn: 我昨天看电影。／我天天看电影。／我正在看电影。（动词全不变）
contrast.en: I watched... / I watch... / I am watching...
contrast.diff: 中文靠时间词报时，动词永远原样；英语把时刻和状态都压进动词形态——时间词只是帮手，动词才是钟。

contrast.cn: 他说他明天来。（「明天」照说）
contrast.en: He said he would come the next day.
contrast.diff: 中文转述不换挡；英语要把将来退成过去将来 would，连 tomorrow 也换成 the next day（G40）。

contrast.cn: 我到的时候他已经走了。（「已经」二字搞定）
contrast.en: He had left when I arrived.
contrast.diff: 中文用「已经」标先后；英语给更早的动作盖 had done 的章——先后写进动词里。

contrast.cn: 雨停了我们就走。（没有 will 的问题）
contrast.en: We'll go when the rain stops.
contrast.diff: 中文从句无所谓将来不将来；英语时间从句借现在式替将来——will 不进门。

contrast.cn: 我住这儿三年了。（「了」一字多义）
contrast.en: I have lived here for three years.
contrast.diff: 中文的「了」身兼数职；英语用 have done + for 明确「从过去延到现在」——G26 的延音线挂在坐标系的完成行上。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 先横后纵再组装：基准点定横轴，动作状态定纵轴；will 推时刻、be...ing 点灯、have...done 盖章。
steps: 找基准点：扫时间词和上下文——现在？过去？将来？还是「过去说的将来」？横轴落定。
问状态：动作在基准点是常态、演到一半、还是之前已收工？纵轴落定。
横竖一交，用零件组装：will/would 挪时刻，be + doing 进行，have + done 完成。
对表纪律自查：具体过去时间→一般过去；since/for→完成；时间条件从句→现在替将来；主句过去→从句跟着退。
还犹豫？把句子里所有动词标出来，检查它们是不是站在同一条时间线上——叙事中途不换格（G15）。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，帮我画一张总时间表：横着写四栏——现在、过去、将来、过去说的将来；竖着写三行——平常这样、正做到一半、已经做完。画好咱们玩『把句子放进格子』：我说中文，你先说英语，再指给我看它住哪个格。比如『我每天七点起床』——左上角常态格；『妈妈进来时我正在写作业』——过去×进行格。我不懂英语没关系，我核对两件事：你指的格子和中文意思对不对得上；格子换了，你动词的音有没有跟着换（will、was、have 这些音我听得出来）。」再玩满格挑战：一周内把常用的九个格子各造一句真事，涂掉一格算一格——右下角三个灰格不用涂，那是高中的地盘。
questions: 总时间表的横轴和纵轴各管什么？一共几个格子、常用的是几个？
拼出整张表只需要哪三个零件？各自负责什么？
「我到家时妈妈正在做饭」和「我到家后妈妈做了饭」，格子差在哪？意思差在哪？

sections.echo: 把十二个格子摆成一张表，才看清一件事：整张表的骨架，是由 be、have、will 三个词搭起来的——进行靠 be，完成靠 have，将来靠 will，第一个助动词永远负责报时。而这三个包工头，恰恰是英语里最不规则的三个词：be 有五副面孔（G25 数过），have 有 has 和 had，will 退一步变 would（G38、G40、G43 各用了一次）。英语把最规整的一张坐标系，挂在三个最不讲理的词身上——不是巧合，是分工的必然：正因为它们从古英语时代就天天出勤扛着报时的活儿，才磨出了这些别人没有的形态。规律与例外，从来是一对搭档。

stages.name: 认一认 · 坐标系读格

questions.q: 总时间表的横轴管什么？
options: 时刻——你站在哪个时间点说话
questions.explain: 横轴四时刻：现在、过去、将来、过去将来。

questions.q: 总时间表的纵轴管什么？
options: 状态——一般 / 进行 / 完成
questions.explain: 纵轴三状态：常态、演到一半、之前已收工。

questions.q: 「把时刻往将来挪」的零件是？
questions.explain: will 是推子——推一格进将来；would 是过去那栏的推子。

questions.q: 「正演到一半」的进行灯用哪套零件？
questions.explain: be 报时、doing 亮灯——is playing / was playing。

questions.q: 「在那个时刻之前已收尾」的收工章是？
questions.explain: have 报时、done 盖章——has played / had played。

questions.q: 一句话里负责报时的是哪个词？
questions.explain: will be doing 里报时的是 will——G29 就见过这条分工。

questions.q: She was reading at nine last night. 住哪个格？
questions.explain: 昨晚九点（过去）+ 演到一半（进行）。

questions.q: He has finished the model. 住哪个格？
questions.explain: 此刻之前已收工、影响延到现在——现在 × 完成。

questions.q: They will visit the farm next week. 住哪个格？
questions.explain: 推子推到下周——将来 × 一般。

questions.q: She said she would write soon. 里的 would write 住哪个格？
questions.explain: 站在过去朝后看——过去将来格（G40 的老朋友）。

questions.q: 「过去的过去」该请哪个零件？
questions.explain: 过去那栏的收工章——had done（G28）。

questions.q: will be doing 是哪两个零件拼的？
options: 推子 will + 进行灯 be doing
questions.explain: 将来 × 进行——明晚八点正演到一半。

questions.q: 十二格里初中常用的大约几格？剩下的怎么办？
options: 约九格；灰格认识即可，高中再学
questions.explain: 诚实边界——will have done 那三格罕见，认得出就行。

questions.q: know、like、love 这类状态动词能点进行灯吗？
options: 一般不能——不写 am knowing
questions.explain: 状态不是动作——进行灯点不亮。

questions.q: 横向辨析的第一问是什么？
options: 基准点在哪——扫时间词和上下文
questions.explain: 先定横轴——基准点找错，后面全歪。

questions.q: Our school choir meets on Wednesdays. 住哪个格？
questions.explain: 每周三的常态——左上角的常态格。

questions.q: Look! The little dancer ___ on one leg.
questions.explain: Look 把基准点钉在此刻——现在 × 进行。

questions.q: My grandpa ___ tea every morning — never coffee.
questions.explain: 常态格——一般现在 drinks。

questions.q: We ___ a sandcastle on the beach yesterday afternoon.
questions.explain: yesterday afternoon 具体过去时间——一般过去。

questions.q: At eight last night, I ___ a shower, so I missed your call.
questions.explain: 昨晚八点演到一半——过去 × 进行。

questions.q: Hurry up! The film ___ in five minutes.
questions.explain: 五分钟后——推子推进将来。

questions.q: She ___ her homework already — she's free now.
questions.explain: already + 影响延到现在——现在 × 完成。

questions.q: When the phone rang, Dad ___ the dishes.
questions.explain: 电话响时演到一半——was washing；washed 就成了「响完才洗」。

questions.q: By the time we reached the stop, the last bus ___.
questions.explain: 「到站」之前就走了——过去的过去，had gone。

questions.q: He promised he ___ me the comic the next day.
questions.explain: promised 站在过去——从句的将来退成 would。

questions.q: We'll go out as soon as the snow ___.
questions.explain: 时间从句现在替将来——will 不进 as soon as 的门。

questions.q: My cousin ___ in Kunming since last spring.
questions.explain: since 挂完成——从去年春天延到现在。

questions.q: Don't visit us at noon tomorrow — we ___ then.
questions.explain: 明天中午正忙到一半——will be doing（推子+进行灯）。

questions.q: I ___ the answer, so I put up my hand at once.
questions.explain: 状态动词不点进行灯——过去的状态用 knew。

questions.q: The choir ___ that song three times this week.
questions.explain: this week 还没过完——次数累计到现在，现在 × 完成。

questions.q: While I ___ the floor, my brother was wiping the windows.
questions.explain: while 两边同时演到一半——双进行灯。

questions.q: The coach said the team ___ hard enough that season.
questions.explain: said 之前的那段训练——过去的过去，hadn't trained。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（我上个月读完了这本小说）
options: I finished the novel last month.
I have finished the novel last month.
I finish the novel last month.
questions.explain: last month 具体过去时间——一般过去，完成章盖不上。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（雨一停我们就出发）
options: We'll set off when the rain stops.
We'll set off when the rain will stop.
We set off when the rain stopped tomorrow.
questions.explain: 时间从句现在替将来。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（他说他第二天会还书）
options: He said he would return the book the next day.
He said he will return the book the next day.
He says he would return the book tomorrow.
questions.explain: said 在过去——will 退成 would。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（听！合唱队正在排练）
questions.explain: Listen 钉住此刻——进行灯亮。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（我们到影院时电影已经开场了）
options: The film had started when we got to the cinema.
The film started when we got to the cinema.
The film has started when we got to the cinema.
questions.explain: 比「到影院」更早——had started；用 started 就成了我们一到它才开场。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（她从三岁起就弹钢琴）
options: She has played the piano since she was three.
She plays the piano since she was three.
She played the piano since she is three.
questions.explain: since 挂完成——has played；从句里的「三岁时」用过去。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（昨天这个时候我们正在爬山）
options: We were climbing the hill at this time yesterday.
We climbed the hill at this time yesterday.
We have climbed the hill at this time yesterday.
questions.explain: 昨天此刻演到一半——过去 × 进行。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（别担心，我明天会带伞的）
options: Don't worry — I will take an umbrella tomorrow.
Don't worry — I take an umbrella tomorrow.
Don't worry — I took an umbrella tomorrow.
questions.explain: 明天的事——推子 will。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（我特别喜欢这个新同桌）
options: I like my new deskmate very much.
I am liking my new deskmate very much.
I have been liking my new deskmate.
questions.explain: like 是状态动词——不点进行灯。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（爸爸做饭时我在摆碗筷）
options: While Dad was cooking, I was setting the table.
While Dad cooked, I set the table tomorrow.
While Dad was cooking, I have set the table.
questions.explain: 两件事同时演到一半——双进行灯，同站过去。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（那时他已经学了两年小提琴）
options: He had learned the violin for two years by then.
He has learned the violin for two years by then.
He learns the violin for two years by then.
questions.explain: by then 把参照点钉在过去——过去的完成 had learned。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（这周我已经迟到两次了——还没到周末）
options: I have been late twice this week.
I was late twice this week and it is over.
I am late twice this week.
questions.explain: this week 未结束——累计到现在用现在完成。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（导游说大巴八点出发，让我们别迟到）
options: The guide said the bus would leave at eight.
The guide said the bus will leaves at eight.
The guide says the bus would left at eight.
questions.explain: said 在过去——would leave；leave 保持原形。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（如果明天不下雨，我们就去放风筝）
options: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will fly kites.
If it won't rain tomorrow, we will fly kites.
If it didn't rain tomorrow, we will fly kites.
questions.explain: 条件从句同样现在替将来——if 里不放 will（G35；G43 的空想才退步）。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（讲故事：小狐狸跳过篱笆，钻进了菜园）
options: The fox jumped over the fence and slipped into the garden.
The fox jumps over the fence and slipped into the garden.
The fox jumped over the fence and slips into the garden.
questions.explain: 叙事全程一条时间线——两个动词同站过去格（G15 的纪律）。

questions.q: 哪句对表了？（下周日上午十点，我们会正在彩排——别约我）
options: We will be rehearsing at ten next Sunday morning.
We rehearse at ten next Sunday and it was fun.
We have rehearsed at ten next Sunday morning.
questions.explain: 将来某刻演到一半——will be rehearsing。

stages.name: 用一用 · 横向大辨析

questions.q: 同一个动作三种说法：哪组「格子—意思」全配对？
options: She waters the flowers（常态）/ She is watering them（此刻）/ She watered them（昨天）
She waters the flowers（此刻）/ She is watering them（常态）/ She watered them（明天）
questions.explain: 同一动作换格子换意思——常态 / 此刻 / 过去，各居其位。

questions.q: 写周记开头「上周六我们去了植物园」，动词该站哪格？
questions.explain: 上周六是具体过去时间——一般过去开场，后面全程别跳格。

questions.q: ___ you ever ___ a hot spring? — Yes, twice.
questions.explain: ever + 到现在为止的经历——现在 × 完成。

questions.q: When I opened the curtain, it ___ outside, so I put on my raincoat.
questions.explain: 拉开窗帘那刻雨正下到一半——过去 × 进行。

questions.q: The librarian told us the reading room ___ at five that day.
questions.explain: told 在过去——将来退成 would close。

questions.q: 先后排序：Before the guests arrived, Mum ___ the whole house.
questions.explain: 打扫在客人到之前——过去的过去 had tidied。

questions.q: 口头承诺：别催啦，我马上就洗碗！
options: I will do the dishes right now!
I did the dishes right now!
I had done the dishes right now!
questions.explain: 当场作出的决定——will（G16：临时起意归 will）。

questions.q: My pen pal ___ me three postcards since we ___ writing to each other.
questions.explain: 主句挂 since 用完成；since 从句里的起点用一般过去。

questions.q: 读日记判断格子："At 7:30 I was brushing my teeth." 为什么不用 brushed？
options: 因为想说 7:30 那一刻正刷到一半
因为 brush 是状态动词
因为日记必须用进行时
questions.explain: 选进行灯是为了「定格在动作中间」——brushed 只说做过这件事。

questions.q: Dad ___ in this factory for twenty years — he still works there.
questions.explain: still works 说明延到现在——现在 × 完成；worked 就是已经不干了。

questions.q: 转述接力：Lily said, "I am practising for the contest." → Lily said she ___ for the contest.
questions.explain: 转述退一步（G40）——现在进行退成过去进行。

questions.q: The plane ___ off when we rushed into the airport — we missed it by minutes.
questions.explain: 起飞在「冲进机场」之前——had taken off。

questions.q: 哪句最能表达「已经约好、板上钉钉的安排」？
options: We are visiting the fire station on Friday.
We visited the fire station on Friday.
We had visited the fire station on Friday.
questions.explain: 现在进行表已定安排——地道用法（红黑榜灰区那条）。

questions.q: 看图讲故事最稳的时态策略是？
options: 开头定一条时间线（通常过去），全程不跳格
每句换一个格子显得丰富
questions.explain: 叙事一致是阅卷第一眼——G15 的纪律在总表里依然是铁律。

questions.q: Grandma says she ___ dumplings for us when we ___ her next month.
questions.explain: says 是现在——主句 will make；时间从句 visit 现在替将来。

questions.q: 大考：I ___ my homework when Mum came in; she said she ___ shopping and ___ back in an hour.
options: was doing / was going / would be
was doing / will go / would be
questions.explain: 妈妈进来时演到一半（was doing）；她说的话全程退一步（was going / would be）——一句话横跨三个格子。

detective.sentence: I have visited the flower market last Saturday.
detective.fixed: I visited the flower market last Saturday.
detective.clue: last Saturday 是具体过去时间——只配一般过去，现在完成的章盖不上。

detective.sentence: Listen! Someone plays the violin in the next room.
detective.fixed: Listen! Someone is playing the violin in the next room.
detective.clue: Listen 把基准点钉在此刻——正演到一半要点进行灯。

detective.sentence: When I came in, my sister did her homework at the desk.
detective.fixed: When I came in, my sister was doing her homework at the desk.
detective.clue: 想说「进来时正在写」——did 成了我进来后她才动笔，先后被改写。

detective.sentence: He told me he will bring the map the next day.
detective.fixed: He told me he would bring the map the next day.
detective.clue: told 站在过去——从句的将来要退成 would（过去将来格）。

detective.sentence: We will start the picnic when the rain will stop.
detective.fixed: We will start the picnic when the rain stops.
detective.clue: 时间从句用现在替将来——will 不进 when 的门。

detective.sentence: By the time we got to the station, the train already left.
detective.fixed: By the time we got to the station, the train had already left.
detective.clue: 火车走在「我们赶到」之前——过去的过去要盖 had done 的章。

detective.sentence: She is liking the new song very much these days.
detective.fixed: She likes the new song very much these days.
detective.clue: like 是状态动词——进行灯点不亮。
